metadata.name: ThirdPartyFraudDetection
metadata.description: This webhook is triggered when third party fraud detection.

request_fields.name: UpdateCallList
request_fields.description: Group of fields passed in webhook

request_fields.name: InfoAlert
request_fields.description: Group of fields passed in webhook

request_fields.name: Tab
request_fields.description: Indicates tab in system under which this webhook is available Possible value: Status, Period, Monetary, Security and Cards Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: Category
request_fields.description: Indicates category of alert triggered Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: SubCategory
request_fields.description: Indicates subcategory of Category of alert triggered Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: CaseID
request_fields.description:
Unique ID assigned to each Dispute case
Valid Values:0-9
Format:XXXXXXX
Example:9856198

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: First name of the cardholder associated with the transaction being disputed. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Last Name of the cardholder associated with the transaction being disputed. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: Status
request_fields.description: Current Status of card Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: CardExpiryMonthAndYear
request_fields.description: Month and Year details when Card will expire Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: Xmonths
request_fields.description: No activity was performed on this card for X number of months, which triggered this webhook Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: AvailableBalance
request_fields.description: Available Balance to make new transactions.

request_fields.name: StatementMonth
request_fields.description:
Denote month for which statement is generated 
Valid values: 1 to 12 Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: XAmount
request_fields.description: Amount Due on the account which was to be paid before payment due date

request_fields.name: TransactionCurrencyCode
request_fields.description:
Currency code in which transaction was performed   
Example: USD Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Total amount for which transaction occurred

request_fields.name: PrimaryCurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Primary currency defined for the client during setup. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: LoyaltyPointsExpirationDate
request_fields.description: The expiration date of the loyalty points.

request_fields.name: LoyaltyPoints
request_fields.description: The total number of loyalty points accumulated by the user.

request_fields.name: PaymentDueDate
request_fields.description:
Due date as to by when payment needs to be made to avoid late fees
Valid Values: 0-9
Format: mmddyyyy
Example: 02012020

request_fields.name: CardnumLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Last 4 digits of card number associated with the transaction being disputed. Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: LifeCycleID
request_fields.description: Unique identifier to identify transaction across multiple phases like pre-auth, reversal, completion Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: AuthTranID
request_fields.description: A unique identifier value for authorization transaction Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: POSCardPresenceIndicator
request_fields.description:
Indicates if Card was present for the transaction or not.
Valid Value:0 - Not Present,1 - Present,9 - Token Transaction Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: CardAcceptorNameLocation
request_fields.description: Name and Location of Merchant where transaction occurred Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: ResponseCode
request_fields.description: Indicates transaction response status. 00 for Approved otherwise declined Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: AmountCurrencyConversionAssessment
request_fields.description: The details of the amount involved in a currency conversion.

request_fields.name: CrossBorderIndicator
request_fields.description:
Indicates if the transaction occurred was international or not 
Valid Value: Y/N Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: LocalTransactionDate
request_fields.description:
Local date and time of transaction
(FORMAT: MMDDYYYYhhnnss)

request_fields.name: InterchangeFee
request_fields.description: For processing a credit or debit card payment.

request_fields.name: InFavorOf
request_fields.description: Indicates party in favor of which dispute was reversed Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ReasonCode
request_fields.description:
Dispute reason code that is sent to/from Mastercard
Valid Value: 0 - Merchandise Not Ordered,1 - Merchandise Not Received - To Customer ,2 - Merchandise Not Received - From Customer,3 - Sent Payment Not Applied,4 - Product not as described,5 - Defective Merchandise ,6 - Billing Error,7 - Duplicate Processing ,8 - Clarification ,9 -Other ,10 -Fraud  ,11 -Authorization  ,12 -Processing Errors ,13 -Cardholder Disputes Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: ReasonDescription
request_fields.description:
Dispute reason description that is sent to/from Network
Valid Value: 0 - Merchandise Not Ordered,1 - Merchandise Not Received - To Customer ,2 - Merchandise Not Received - From Customer,3 - Sent Payment Not Applied,4 - Product not as described,5 - Defective Merchandise ,6 - Billing Error,7 - Duplicate Processing ,8 - Clarification ,9 -Other ,10 -Fraud  ,11 -Authorization  ,12 -Processing Errors ,13 -Cardholder Disputes Allowable Values: 60

request_fields.name: PaymentScheduleType
request_fields.description:
Indicates type of payment for payment schedule which triggered payment 
Valid values: Statement Balance or Minimum Due or Fixed Amount or Current Balance Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: PaymentScheduleDate
request_fields.description: Date when payment schedule was Added(FORMAT: YYYYMMDD)

request_fields.name: OldCreditLimit
request_fields.description: Previous Credit Limit on account.

request_fields.name: NewCreditLimit
request_fields.description: New Credit Limit on account.

request_fields.name: AvailableOTB
request_fields.description: Amount available for further purchases on card

request_fields.name: BankName
request_fields.description: Name of bank whose account was used to create payment schedule Allowable Values: 70

request_fields.name: ScheduleID
request_fields.description: Unique identifier assigned by the system for the added payment schedule Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: PaymentTransactionID
request_fields.description: Unique identifier for Transaction ID of Payment made - Reversed Payment or Original ? Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PaymentScheduleFrequency
request_fields.description:
Indicates Frequency with which paymentschedule was added 
Possible values: Monthly Specific Day, Payment Due Date, One Time, Weekly Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: AuthStatus
request_fields.description: Indicates whether the transaction is authorized, declined, or in another state.

request_fields.name: CheckNumber
request_fields.description: The check number associated with the transaction.

request_fields.name: BaseCommerceErrorMessages
request_fields.description: Contains details of any issues or errors encountered during the processing of the transaction.

request_fields.name: OldAdminNumber
request_fields.description: Previous Admin Number associated with card.

request_fields.name: BankAccountLast4Digit
request_fields.description: Last 4 digits of bank account number involved in this Transaction Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: AccountGraceFlag
request_fields.description: This flag shows if the account holder is temporarily exempt from penalties or restrictions.

request_fields.name: OverdueNoSpend
request_fields.description: Indicates whether the account is restricted from spending due to overdue payments.

request_fields.name: GraceFlagChangeDate
request_fields.description: The date when the grace period flag was last updated or changed.

request_fields.name: PaymentReferenceId
request_fields.description: Unique identifier for Payment Transaction Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: OTBReleaseAmount
request_fields.description: Amount released which impacts Open-To-Buy ability of account

request_fields.name: HoldOTBReleaseDate
request_fields.description: Date, when Open-To-Buy payment held, is to be released

request_fields.name: ReleaseStatus
request_fields.description: Indicates if Payment hold release is manual or auto-release Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: BankMethodName
request_fields.description: Unique Identifier for the bank account in CoreCard system Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CancellationReason
request_fields.description: String 'Active' will be mentioned in this field Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: UnpostedInterestOwed
request_fields.description: The amount of interest that has been accrued but not yet posted to the account.

request_fields.name: TimeStamp
request_fields.description: The date and time at which an event or transaction occurred, formatted as a timestamp.

request_fields.name: TransactionUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description: Unique identifier created during pre-auth to identify transaction across multiple phases like pre-auth, reversal, completion

request_fields.name: ReferenceUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description: A universally unique identifier used as a reference for the transaction or entity.

request_fields.name: CurrentBalance
request_fields.description: Updated Current Balance of Account

request_fields.name: AccountClosedReason
request_fields.description: Reason provided for Card closure Allowable Values: 70

request_fields.name: BTStatusCode
request_fields.description:
Status Code for Balance Transfer process
Valid values: 0, null Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: PayeeAccountNumber
request_fields.description:
Account number of Payee Account
Valid Values:0-9
Format:XXXXXXXXXX
Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: PayeeAccountType
request_fields.description: Account Type of Payee account Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: PaymentProcessDate
request_fields.description:
This is the date when the BillpaymentSource(IPAY) initiated the payment to the subscriber system.
Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss
Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: BTStatusMessage
request_fields.description: Status message for Balance Transfer Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: DateOfCancellation
request_fields.description:
Date when initiated Balance Transfer process is reversed or canceled 
Format: - dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss

request_fields.name: StatementID
request_fields.description:
Unique identifier for Statement
Valid Values:0-9
Format: XX

request_fields.name: StatementDate
request_fields.description:
Date when statement was generated
Format: YYYYMMDDHHMMSS

request_fields.name: PrimaryEmail
request_fields.description: Email ID of Primary cardholder. This field is available only when AlertRecipientType is 1 or 3 or 5 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CosignerEmailID
request_fields.description: Email ID of Cosigner on account. This field is available only when AlertRecipientType is 2 or 3 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: AuthUserEmailID
request_fields.description: Email ID of Secondary cardholder. This field is available only when AlertRecipientType is 4 or 5 Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: PaymentEffectiveDate
request_fields.description:
Indicates actual payment schedule date considering the bank holidays and weekends.
Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:mm 
Example: 01/01/2020 11:05:05

request_fields.name: Third Party Fraud Response
request_fields.description: Array Data element to hold Third Party Fraud Response data.

request_fields.name: Lifecycle_id
request_fields.description: Unique identifier to identify transaction across multiple phases like pre-auth, reversal, completion

request_fields.name: Event_external_id
request_fields.description: The unique identifier, on the client's platform, of this event. This field has the same value as the one on the request and it will not be present on the response if it's not present on the request.

request_fields.name: Score
request_fields.description: The risk engine score, which measures the probability of a transfer being legitimate or not. Possible values range from 0 to 1000, where 1000 represents the highest probability of being illegitimate.

request_fields.name: Decision
request_fields.description: Feedzai's suggestion of whether to approve or decline the transfer based on the decision outcome of the Pulse workflow.

request_fields.name: Alert
request_fields.description: Identifies whether or not the request has generated an alert in Feedzai Case Manager.

request_fields.name: First Fraud Rule and Action
request_fields.description: Actions that are activated when the first rule is triggered.

request_fields.name: Other Fraud Rules and Actions
request_fields.description: Actions that are activated by every other triggering rule except the first.

request_fields.name: Fraud SCA Required
request_fields.description: Identifies whether the strong customer authentication (SCA) is needed or not.

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description:
Account Number associated with the event. The Account Number is consistently maintained at the Account level (one-to-one Mapping).
Valid Values: 0-9
Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Example: 8000000000000037 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description:
Admin Number associated with the event. Admin Number is always associated with a Card (Can be Primary or Secondary)
Valid Values:0-9
Format:XXXXX
Example:12345

request_fields.name: RequestID
request_fields.description:
Primary Key for API
Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX
Example:12345 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: Mode
request_fields.description: Indicates the type of activity performed which triggered this webhook Possible Value: Alert, Insert, Transaction Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: AccountUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
UniversalUniqueID of Account
Format:XXXXXXXXXX
Example:7408f969-6e0c-4a3f-8fba-3316f6f77db6 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: CardUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
UniversalUniqueID of Card

request_fields.name: ClientID
request_fields.description: Corecard's Client ID Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: RequestUniversalUniqueID
request_fields.description:
UniversalUniqueID Request
Example: 8638-b87b-48d0-8e13-0ebb5643577 Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: User

User ID of the user who triggered the webhook event.

request_fields.name: DateandTime
request_fields.description:
Timestamp when notification was sent
YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss:sss
(24-hour Format)

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description:
Indicates the source from where the activity was performed by user or triggered by system.
Valid Values: CoreCredit, External API, Self Service, CoreCollect, IVR, System, CoreIssue Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: ServiceName
request_fields.description: Name of API service (webhook) triggered Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: AlertType
request_fields.description:
Indicates type of Alert

Real-Time or Re Try(due to time-out) Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: TransactionSource

request_fields.name: InstitutionID

request_fields.name: ProductID
